benchmark.name: SkillFlow
benchmark.liftDefinition: On the same family and task order, mean(evolved_pass - vanilla_pass). Ranking uses lift, not absolute pass rate.

taskBackbone.note: Every main-table arm uses this same backbone. Do not start until the endpoint and revision are written into model-lock.json by the run window.

systemRule: The full Janus system runs each task. Only the detective's single minimal update is carried to the next task. D staffs the initial team. S chooses a replacement. Do not let every agent write its own library.

baselines.name: ExpeL
baselines.update: Cross-task natural-language insights plus successful trajectories as examples.

baselines.name: Agent Workflow Memory
baselines.update: Induce reusable workflows from successful trajectories and inject them later.

baselines.name: ReasoningBank
baselines.update: Distill reasoning memory from both successes and failures.

baselines.name: SkillRL
baselines.update: Hierarchical skill bank; failed validation adds skills and the policy co-evolves.

baselines.name: CoWork-X
baselines.update: Multi-agent execute-then-consolidate of the shared skill library after each episode.

baselines.name: RSEA
baselines.update: Recursive context rewrite kept only when a held-out slice does not get worse.
